given: the up migration has been applied to the stock table
when: the down migration is run as a full up-then-down round trip
then: inventory_code is re-added and reconstructed from canonical location + batch_number + serial_number, the batch_number and serial_number columns are dropped, and the pre-migration schema shape is restored cleanly
architectural_notes: Infra reversibility contract realized by PI3-migration-reversible (migration_reversible): the Alembic downgrade rebuilds inventory_code from canonical location + the two new columns, drops them, and restores the original schema shape. Verified by an R4/NFR-F6-4 real-branch up-then-down round-trip test asserting inventory_code reconstructed and the column set restored (scoped per the down-migration-lossiness risk noted by the Architect).

independence.rationale: AC1-AC5 assert the forward migration's backfill, survival, probe, and drop; AC6 asserts the reverse path. The downgrade can break (fail to reconstruct inventory_code or leave the new columns) while the entire forward migration is correct, and vice versa
